info.name: GST Tool — Book Data Connectors API (Final)
info.description:
API key management for inbound ERP connectors.

**Base URL**: http://localhost:3002

**Auth**: JWT Bearer token (verifyToken) + SUPER_ADMIN role check.
Only a system Super Admin can call these endpoints.

**Key Design**:
- One record per workspace/organization
- `production_key` → for live data pushes
- `sandbox_key` → for testing/demo
- `status`: active | inactive
- `mode`: live | demo

**How SuperAdmin creates a key**:
1. Login as SuperAdmin → get JWT
2. POST /connectors/api-keys with body `{ tenant_id, workspace_id }`
3. Share the production_key or sandbox_key with the ERP connector

**How ERP connector authenticates**:
- POST /connectors/validate-key with body `{ api_key: "prod_xxx..." }`
- No JWT needed for validate-key (public endpoint)

item.name: 🔑 API Key Management (SUPER_ADMIN only)
item.description:
All endpoints here require:
- Authorization: Bearer <superadmin_jwt>
- Body/Query must include tenant_id + workspace_id of the TARGET organization

The SuperAdmin's own workspace is irrelevant — they operate cross-tenant.

request.description:
Get the API key record for a specific organization.

Query params:
- `tenant_id` (required) — the target tenant
- `workspace_id` (required) — the target organization/workspace

Returns null if no keys configured yet.

response.name: 200 OK — No Keys Yet
403 Forbidden — Not Super Admin
404 Not Found — Bad tenant/workspace

request.description:
Create production + sandbox API keys for a specific organization.

Body (required):
- `tenant_id` — which tenant owns this organization
- `workspace_id` — the target organization/workspace

Returns 409 if keys already exist.
Use POST /api-keys/regenerate to rotate existing keys.

response.name: 200 OK — Keys Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "API keys created for workspace \"Acme Corp\"",
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid-here",
    "tenant_id": "{{tenant_id}}",
    "workspace_id": "{{workspace_id}}",
    "status": "active",
    "mode": "live",
    "production_key": "prod_4f2a9e1b3c7d...",
    "sandbox_key": "sand_7e3b1f9d2a5c...",
    "created_at": "2026-05-14T08:00:00.000Z"
  }
}

response.name: 409 Conflict — Already Exists

request.description:
Update status or mode for an organization's API keys.

Body (required):
- `tenant_id`
- `workspace_id`
- `status`: "active" | "inactive"  (optional)
- `mode`: "live" | "demo"  (optional)

At least one of status or mode is required.

Example use cases:
- Set status=inactive to block all inbound ERP pushes
- Set mode=demo to route all data to sandbox

Rotate keys for a specific organization.
Old key is immediately invalidated — ERP connector must be reconfigured.

Body:
- `tenant_id` (required)
- `workspace_id` (required)
- `which`: "production" | "sandbox" | "both"  (default: "both")

response.name: 200 OK — Rotated

request.description:
Permanently delete the API key record for a specific organization.
Both production and sandbox keys are destroyed.

⚠️ Irreversible — must POST /api-keys again to re-create.

Body:
- `tenant_id` (required)
- `workspace_id` (required)

response.name: 200 OK — Deleted

item.name: 🔐 ERP Connector Auth (Public)
item.description: No JWT required. Called by external ERP connectors to authenticate inbound data pushes.

request.description:
PUBLIC — No JWT required.

Called by the ERP connector (e.g. Tally plugin) to authenticate before pushing data.
Send either the production_key or sandbox_key.

Response tells you:
- `workspaceId` — which organization to import data into
- `tenantId` — which tenant owns it
- `mode` — live or demo (so import pipeline knows how to tag the data)
- `keyType` — production or sandbox
